lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，鳞片闪着碎银。
lines.en: I skim the sandy floor, scales flashing like broken silver.

lines.zh: 整群一起转向，海水被我们搅亮。
lines.en: The whole school turns at once, brightening the water.

lines.zh: 我绕着珊瑚根打转，找浮游的碎屑。
lines.en: I circle the coral roots, hunting drifting scraps.

lines.zh: 水流推我向前，我懒得自己用力。
lines.en: The current pushes me along, so I barely swim.

lines.zh: 我钻过海草缝，银光一闪就没了。
lines.en: I slip through the seagrass gap and my silver vanishes.

lines.zh: 身后的同伴撞我尾巴，我加速。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps my tail, and I speed up.

lines.zh: 我沿海沟边缘游，避开大鱼的影子。
lines.en: I follow the trench edge, dodging big shadows.

lines.zh: 沙粒被我们扬起，像一层低雾。
lines.en: We kick up sand until it hangs like low fog.

lines.zh: 我贴着沉船木板游，鳞色染上铁锈。
lines.en: I swim past wreck planks, my scales picking up rust.

lines.zh: 潮线变了，我调头往浅滩去。
lines.en: The tide line shifts, so I turn for the shallows.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏和整群一样快。
lines.en: My tailbeat matches the whole school's pace.

lines.zh: 我从礁石缺口挤过去，鳞片刮出响。
lines.en: I squeeze through a reef gap, scales scraping.

lines.zh: 我在水面下兜圈，追一缕光斑。
lines.en: I loop beneath the surface, chasing a patch of light.

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴的侧腹，保持队形。
lines.en: I hug my neighbor's flank to hold the formation.

lines.zh: 我从礁缝里钻出来，银光一片。
lines.en: I slip from the reef gap in a flash of silver.

lines.zh: 我跟着队伍拐进海草床。
lines.en: I follow the school into the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我摆尾贴着沙面滑过去。
lines.en: A flick of my tail and I skim the sand.

lines.zh: 我绕着沉船的桅杆游了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the wreck's mast once.

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼群，尾巴轻轻摆。
lines.en: I follow the school, tail barely moving.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，我们挤成一小团银。
lines.en: Schoolmates crowd in until we are one silver knot.

lines.zh: 我张嘴滤水，咽下看不见的浮游。
lines.en: I gulp water and swallow invisible plankton.

lines.zh: 光从上面落下来，我鳞片发白。
lines.en: Light falls from above and turns my scales white.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，假装自己是块碎石。
lines.en: I stay still and pretend to be a chip of stone.

lines.zh: 海草擦过我的背，我没理它。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my back and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水流洗过鳃盖。
lines.en: I tilt to let the current rinse my gill covers.

lines.zh: 远处有条大鱼，我压低身子。
lines.en: A big fish passes far off, and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴轻轻定住位置。
lines.en: I use small tail flicks to hold position.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我的影子，很淡。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is faint and small.

lines.zh: 我数不清身边有多少同伴。
lines.en: I cannot count how many schoolmates surround me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，又合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth wide, then close it.

lines.zh: 水面上的波纹晃得我头晕。
lines.en: Ripples overhead make my head swim.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块贝壳，听里面空响。
lines.en: I rest by an empty shell and hear it hum.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一团，银光乱闪。
lines.en: We bunch together in a flash of silver.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我先退半尺。
lines.en: Your shadow drops, and I back off a hand's width.

lines.zh: 我转过来，用一只眼睛盯你。
lines.en: I turn and pin you with one eye.

lines.zh: 你手里有桶，我记得那东西。
lines.en: You hold a bucket, and I remember that thing.

lines.zh: 我游到你腿边，又猛地散开。
lines.en: I dart to your legs, then scatter.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，我看清了你的脸。
lines.en: When you crouch, I finally see your face.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只怕你脚下的网。
lines.en: I don't fear you, only the net at your feet.

lines.zh: 你拍水，我鳞片跟着一颤。
lines.en: You slap the water and my scales flinch.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，保持距离。
lines.en: I circle you halfway, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 你的倒影比我整群都大。
lines.en: Your reflection is bigger than my whole school.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片被削掉一片，银光乱飞。
lines.en: A scale is sliced off and silver flies everywhere.

lines.zh: 疼让我整群散开。
lines.en: The pain scatters my whole school.

lines.zh: 我伤口渗出血丝，水变腥了。
lines.en: Blood threads from my wound and the water turns rank.

lines.zh: 我被拍得贴在沙上，动不了。
lines.en: The blow pins me to the sand and I can't move.

lines.zh: 我拼命摆尾，只想逃开。
lines.en: I thrash my tail with everything, just to escape.

lines.zh: 这一下让我忘了队形。
lines.en: The hit makes me forget the formation.

lines.zh: 我的鳃盖急促开合。
lines.en: My gill covers flap in quick panic.

lines.zh: 我疼得钻进珊瑚缝里。
lines.en: I hurt so much that I wedge into a coral crack.

lines.zh: 血味会引来更大的鱼。
lines.en: The blood will draw bigger fish.

lines.zh: 我翻着白肚，又硬撑过来。
lines.en: I roll belly-up, then force myself right again.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑散开，我凑近。
lines.en: The crumbs you scatter spread out, and I drift closer.

lines.zh: 我闻到水里的味道，先绕一圈。
lines.en: I taste the change in the water and circle once first.

lines.zh: 同伴先冲过去，我才跟上。
lines.en: A schoolmate darts in first, and only then do I follow.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试试，又吐出来。
lines.en: I take a mouthful, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 那团浑浊里有吃的，我忍不住。
lines.en: There is food in that murk, and I can't resist.

lines.zh: 我靠近一寸，尾巴还在犹豫。
lines.en: I inch closer while my tail still hesitates.

lines.zh: 你手一动，我整群往后退。
lines.en: Your hand moves, and the whole school backs away.

lines.zh: 我把饵含在嘴里，没咽下去。
lines.en: I hold the morsel in my mouth without swallowing.

lines.zh: 这味道像浮游，又不太像。
lines.en: It tastes like plankton, but not quite.

lines.zh: 我抢了一口，立刻游开。
lines.en: I snatch a bite and immediately swim off.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞散了我们。
lines.en: You step into the water and break us apart.

lines.zh: 我被你的膝盖顶开，翻了个身。
lines.en: Your knee shoves me aside and I roll over.

lines.zh: 桶壁撞上我的侧腹，很硬。
lines.en: The bucket wall strikes my flank, hard.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我撞回去。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps me, and I bump back.

lines.zh: 我被挤到礁石上，鳞片掉了两片。
lines.en: I'm squeezed onto the reef and lose two scales.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我整条弹开。
lines.en: You touch me and my whole body springs away.

lines.zh: 水流被搅乱，我撞进海草。
lines.en: The current churns and I blunder into seagrass.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子撞上你的靴子。
lines.en: My snout knocks against your boot.

lines.zh: 一群鱼挤过来，我无处可躲。
lines.en: The school presses in and I have nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转圈，分不清方向。
lines.en: The hit spins me until I lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 我追着一条更亮的同伴打转。
lines.en: I chase a brighter schoolmate in slow circles.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳞光叠成一片。
lines.en: We swim side by side, our silver overlapping.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴碰她的侧腹。
lines.en: I tap her flank with my tail.

lines.zh: 水里的银色忽然密了起来。
lines.en: The silver in the water suddenly thickens.

lines.zh: 她把卵撒进海草，我跟着。
lines.en: She scatters eggs into the seagrass and I follow.

lines.zh: 跟紧我，别被大鱼冲散。
lines.en: Stay close; do not let the big fish scatter us.

lines.zh: 别的雄鱼靠近，我横身挡住。
lines.en: Another male nears, and I block him broadside.

lines.zh: 鱼群转个弯，我们并肩。
lines.en: The school turns, and we swim side by side.

lines.zh: 我围着她游，不敢靠太近。
lines.en: I swim around her, afraid to come too close.

lines.zh: 卵落在沙上，像一层细盐。
lines.en: The eggs settle on the sand like fine salt.

lines.zh: 你掉下的东西沉底，我去啄。
lines.en: What you drop sinks, and I peck at it.

lines.zh: 我以为是食物，咬了块碎石。
lines.en: Thinking it food, I bite a piece of gravel.

lines.zh: 这玩意太重，我叼不动。
lines.en: This thing is too heavy for me to carry.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推着它转了两圈。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth and it spins twice.

lines.zh: 我把鳞片当宝贝，藏进海草。
lines.en: I treat a scale like treasure and hide it in the weeds.

lines.zh: 东西卡在珊瑚缝里，我够不到。
lines.en: It's stuck in a coral crack, out of my reach.

lines.zh: 我试了三次，最后放弃了。
lines.en: I try three times and finally give up.

lines.zh: 你抛下的饵，我一口吞了。
lines.en: I swallow the bait you toss down in one go.

lines.zh: 那东西反光，我跟着游了很远。
lines.en: It glints, and I follow it a long way.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到沙面上，又走了。
lines.en: I push it up onto the sand, then leave.

lines.zh: 有条大鱼靠近，整群突然收紧。
lines.en: A big fish nears and the school snaps tight.

lines.zh: 我看见水里的暗影，先动了。
lines.en: I spot the shadow in the water and move first.

lines.zh: 同伴一闪，我知道该跑了。
lines.en: A schoolmate flashes, and I know to run.

lines.zh: 我盯上一团浮游，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I fix on a cloud of plankton and drift toward it.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁石后动，我停住。
lines.en: Something moves behind the reef, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 浮游的东西落下来，我张嘴。
lines.en: Something drifts down; I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 群体的方向变了，我跟上。
lines.en: The school's direction shifts, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我察觉到水压变化。
lines.en: I feel the change in water pressure.

lines.zh: 那条鲨鱼的影子让我尾巴发僵。
lines.en: The shark's shadow stiffens my tail.

lines.zh: 我先看见它，它还没看见我。
lines.en: I see it first; it hasn't seen me yet.

lines.zh: 我盯着那团浮游，一冲一停。
lines.en: I eye the plankton cloud, darting and pausing.

lines.zh: 大鱼在绕，我贴紧沙底。
lines.en: The big fish circles while I press to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，却不敢进它的范围。
lines.en: I trail it but won't enter its reach.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直对着那个影子。
lines.en: My eye stays fixed on that shadow.

lines.zh: 它转向，我整群跟着转。
lines.en: It turns, and the whole school turns with it.

lines.zh: 我在等它露出侧腹。
lines.en: I wait for it to show its flank.

lines.zh: 水里的味道变了，我咬紧牙。
lines.en: The water's taste changes and I clamp my jaw.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着珊瑚滑过去。
lines.en: I flatten out and slide past the coral.

lines.zh: 它慢下来，我们这群也慢下来。
lines.en: It slows, and our whole school slows with it.

lines.zh: 我离它只剩两个身位。
lines.en: Only two body lengths separate us now.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍边，立刻松口。
lines.en: I nip its fin edge, then let go at once.

lines.zh: 我的牙太小，只能撕下一点皮。
lines.en: My teeth are small; I only tear a little skin.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，算是攻击了。
lines.en: I ram it once, and call that an attack.

lines.zh: 它甩尾，我被拍得翻了身。
lines.en: It slaps its tail and knocks me head over tail.

lines.zh: 我咬空了一口，水灌进嘴里。
lines.en: I bite empty water and it floods my mouth.

lines.zh: 我们一群围着它啄。
lines.en: We peck at it as a school.

lines.zh: 我冲向它的眼睛，又改道。
lines.en: I charge its eye, then veer off.

lines.zh: 我的嘴撞在鳞上，牙发麻。
lines.en: My mouth hits scales and my jaw goes numb.

lines.zh: 它一动，我整群就退了。
lines.en: It moves, and the whole school retreats.

lines.zh: 我咬住水草，以为那是它。
lines.en: I bite seagrass, thinking it was the target.

lines.zh: 我从暖流里散开，落进浅海。
lines.en: I scatter out of the warm current into the shallows.

lines.zh: 第一口水很咸，我记住了。
lines.en: The first mouthful is salty, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 天光透下来，同伴已在身边。
lines.en: Daylight filters down, and schoolmates are already here.

lines.zh: 我们在礁石背风处聚成一群。
lines.en: We gather in the lee of the reef.

lines.zh: 我出生时只有指甲那么长。
lines.en: When I appeared, I was only a fingernail long.

lines.zh: 我们从暖流里散开，落进浅海。
lines.en: We scatter out of the warm current into the shallows.

lines.zh: 沙里还有别的卵，我没管。
lines.en: Other eggs lie in the sand, and I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我摆第一下尾，游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My first tailbeat sends me wobbling.

lines.zh: 海草晃了一下，我躲进去。
lines.en: The seagrass sways and I hide inside it.

lines.zh: 我听见远处鲸鸣似的低响。
lines.en: I hear a low call far off, like a whale's.

lines.zh: 水是凉的，火却在我鳞上烧。
lines.en: The water is cold, yet fire burns on my scales.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下，摔得鳞片发麻。
lines.en: I drop from the surface and my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会闷，鳃里进了沙。
lines.en: Even in water I suffocate when sand fills my gills.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我整条被掀翻。
lines.en: The water bursts apart and I'm flipped over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水，钉进我的侧腹。
lines.en: An arrow knifes through the water into my flank.

lines.zh: 那股紫光让我鳞片倒竖。
lines.en: That violet light makes my scales stand on end.

lines.zh: 浮游没了，我的肚子贴着脊骨。
lines.en: The plankton is gone and my belly touches my spine.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我整群都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and the whole school freezes.

lines.zh: 世界空了，我的鳃里没有水。
lines.en: The world empties and there is no water in my gills.
